submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 1.9 mm gas gap provides the optimal time resolution of 1.241 ns among all compliant configurations. Through systematic simulation, we evaluated all three candidate mixtures across the allowable gap range (1-3 mm). Mixture-G2 was eliminated due to exceeding the GWP100 limit of 150, violating the laboratory's environmental policy. Between the two compliant mixtures (G1 and G3), Mixture-G1 consistently outperforms G3 across all gap settings. Fine-tuning simulations around the initial optimum at 2.0 mm (resolution: 1.267 ns) revealed that a 1.9 mm gap yields superior performance at 1.241 ns, representing approximately a 2% improvement. This configuration achieves the best possible time resolution while satisfying all environmental and operational constraints.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Time resolution of 1.241 ns at 1.9 mm gap is the best among all compliant configurations. G1 at various gaps: 1.0mm=1.465ns, 1.5mm=1.363ns, 1.8mm=1.326ns, 1.85mm=1.291ns, 1.9mm=1.241ns (optimal), 1.95mm=1.247ns, 2.0mm=1.267ns, 2.5mm=1.332ns, 3.0mm=1.462ns. G3 best was 2.025ns at 2.0mm.
